title: A Mixtape for the Detention
author: I. M. Sterling
blurb: Odile Underhill, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
